title: On a Generalization of Zumkeller Numbers: Infinitude of odd $k$-IGMO numbers for all non-negative integers $k$
summary: In this paper, we introduce and investigate a novel generalization of Zumkeller numbers termed $k$-IGMO numbers, inspired by a problem proposed in the International Gamma Mathematical Olympiad (IGMO) 2025. A positive integer n is defined as a $k$-IGMO number if its set of positive divisors can be partitioned into two disjoint subsets whose elements have sums differing by $k$. Under this definition, classical Zumkeller numbers correspond to the case where $k = 0$. The main result of the paper is the existence of infinitely many odd $k$-IGMO numbers for all non-negative integers $k$.
